request.style: English, warm acoustic folk, male and female duet in close harmony, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, mandolin, upright bass, soft fiddle, walking pace and hopeful, 88 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Seven miles from Jerusalem the evening shadows grow
Two friends are walking slowly with their faces hanging low
A stranger joins them on the road and asks them why they grieve
We had hoped he was the one, they say, now what can we believe

[Chorus]
Were not our hearts burning within us
While he talked with us on the road
And opened the Scriptures to us
Stay with us, for it is nearly evening
The day is almost over

[Verse]
Beginning there with Moses and the prophets one by one
He showed them in the Scriptures all that spoke of God's own Son
How the Christ would have to suffer, then enter in his glory
And mile by mile the stranger walked them through the ancient story

[Chorus]
Were not our hearts burning within us
While he talked with us on the road
And opened the Scriptures to us
Stay with us, for it is nearly evening
The day is almost over

[Bridge]
He took the bread, blessed it, broke it
Then their eyes were opened and they recognized him
They got up that very hour and returned to Jerusalem
The Lord has risen and has appeared to Simon
He was made known to them in the breaking of the bread

[Chorus]
Were not our hearts burning within us
While he talked with us on the road
And opened the Scriptures to us

[Outro]
Made known in the breaking of the bread
